name: Woo Boo
summary: Party guessing game where players predict whether the chooser likes or dislikes three topics to score points.
rules_text: Each player gets 3 Woo (like), 3 Boo (dislike) and 1 So Super Certain token. A Topic Chooser draws 3 Topic cards, looks at both sides, and picks one topic per card to vote on. They place a Woo or Boo face-down on each chosen topic to record their true feeling, hiding the other topic on the card. Other players, ignoring their own preferences, place a Woo or Boo face-down next to each card to predict the chooser's vote, optionally adding the So Super Certain token to one guess for extra confidence. Tokens are revealed one topic at a time. Guessers get 1 point per correct Woo/Boo. A correct So Super Certain scores an extra point, an incorrect one costs -1. The Chooser gets 1 point for each opponent who guessed all three topics correctly. Rotate Chooser clockwise. Play 2-4 full rounds where everyone has been Chooser once. Most points wins.
rating_reason: Party guessing Woos/Boos, opponent modelling, bluff, text playable
